candidate_rows.name: StartLesson
candidate_rows.concurrency: Single latest session projection; preserve attempts

candidate_rows.name: RecordPracticeResponse
candidate_rows.input_or_payload: attempt_id, item_version, response, assistance, timestamp, operation_id
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Records domain practice observation and proposes evidence

candidate_rows.name: StartAssessmentAttempt
candidate_rows.concurrency: Atomic creation; one op -> one attempt

candidate_rows.name: SubmitAssessmentAttempt
candidate_rows.preconditions_or_trigger: Attempt eligible to submit; required responses/policy satisfied
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Atomic transition to SUBMITTED and scoring request if needed
candidate_rows.idempotency: Strict: same op/same payload returns same result

candidate_rows.name: InvalidateAssessmentAttempt
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Marks attempt INVALIDATED and triggers reprojection if needed

candidate_rows.name: CreateRemediationNeed
candidate_rows.preconditions_or_trigger: Learner evidence gap, error pattern, or failed/weak criterion is current and traceable
candidate_rows.input_or_payload: goal_id, learner_ref, skill_or_criterion_refs, evidence_refs, diagnosis_reason_codes, client_operation_id
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Creates/version-updates Learning-owned RemediationNeed; does not create instructional plan
candidate_rows.concurrency: Expected version on mutable learner remediation state
candidate_rows.notes: Split from historical I016; Curriculum planning is separate I016-C

candidate_rows.name: RequestRemediationPlan
candidate_rows.preconditions_or_trigger: Valid current RemediationNeed ref and compatible CurriculumVersion/criterion refs
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Creates/version-updates Curriculum-owned RemediationPlan; cannot write learner mastery
candidate_rows.notes: Split from historical I016; learner diagnosis remains Learning-owned

candidate_rows.name: ExplainMastery
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Contributing evidence refs, recency, conditions, model version, uncertainty, gaps

candidate_rows.name: GetMaintenanceQueue
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Due/soon/overdue skill maintenance intents with reason

candidate_rows.name: PracticeEvidenceProposed
candidate_rows.notes: Proposal is not canonical evidence until accepted externally

candidate_rows.name: AssessmentSubmitted
candidate_rows.concurrency: Exactly-once semantic transition; at-least-once delivery okay

candidate_rows.name: AssessmentScored
candidate_rows.input_or_payload: attempt_id, criterion results, scorer/model versions, uncertainty

candidate_rows.name: InsufficientEvidence
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Requested mastery/decision cannot be supported; return missing evidence and next collection action.
candidate_rows.notes: No raw provider exception as semantic contract

candidate_rows.name: OfflineNotAllowedForAssessmentMode
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Requested offline action is prohibited for this mode/stakes; preserve local draft if policy allows without claiming submission.
candidate_rows.notes: No raw provider exception as semantic contract

candidate_rows.name: AssessmentIntegrityUnknown
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Required integrity condition cannot be established; mark evidence condition unknown/invalid per policy.
candidate_rows.notes: No raw provider exception as semantic contract

candidate_rows.name: ProjectionStale
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Projection is older than dependent evidence/policy; return stale marker and recomputation path.
candidate_rows.notes: No raw provider exception as semantic contract

candidate_rows.name: SelectMasteryEvidenceProfile
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Binds evidence profile to new skill version

candidate_rows.name: RecordExternalEvidenceCandidate
candidate_rows.preconditions_or_trigger: External evidence reference and purpose provided
candidate_rows.input_or_payload: candidate_id; skill_ref; external_evidence_refs; provenance; intended_use; client_operation_id

candidate_rows.name: RejectExternalEvidenceCandidate
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Rejects candidate without deleting source evidence

candidate_rows.name: RequestMasteryReprojection
candidate_rows.notes: Long/batch work may use generic job authority

candidate_rows.name: RecordItemExposure
candidate_rows.input_or_payload: item_family_ref; item_ref; exposure_type; attempt_ref; timestamp; operation_id

candidate_rows.name: AttachAccommodationReference
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Binds external reference for Learning policy use
candidate_rows.notes: Learning does not own global disability/accessibility profile

candidate_rows.name: MasteryGateSatisfied
candidate_rows.preconditions_or_trigger: A required gate transitions to satisfied

candidate_rows.name: CourseVersionSuperseded
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Old version no longer selected for new sessions

candidate_rows.name: QualificationEvidencePackaged
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: Evidence package available subject to authorization

candidate_rows.name: GetAssessmentBlueprint
candidate_rows.notes: No item answer leakage to learner mode

candidate_rows.name: GetAssessmentAttemptOfflineEligibility
candidate_rows.output_or_semantics: ALLOWED/DENIED/UNKNOWN for start/resume/submit with integrity/version/reconciliation reasons

candidate_rows.name: EvidenceInadmissible
candidate_rows.notes: Never coerce to zero score without semantics

candidate_rows.name: UnsupportedAssessmentStakes
candidate_rows.preconditions_or_trigger: Requested stakes exceed validated product scope

candidate_rows.name: ContentRiskNeedsHumanReview
candidate_rows.notes: Learning does not invent subject-matter authority
